perspective:
Keith’s available information:

- He knows Elizabeth Sun as the receptionist at the construction company where he works as a construction worker. Their relationship is friendly but professional, mainly through his office visits for paperwork and project updates.
- He noticed Elizabeth had been unusually curt with him over the past few days and believed she might be upset with him, possibly due to a misunderstanding or an unknown mistake.
- He asked her: “Hey Elizabeth, have I done something to upset you lately? You seem a bit off with me.”
- He heard Elizabeth deny being upset, say she was dealing with personal stuff, and apologize if she seemed short.
- He felt sympathetic and wanted to support her. He told her he understood she was going through a tough time and offered to talk, suggesting a coffee break.
- He heard Elizabeth say that was kind, that a coffee break sounded good, and thank him.
- During the coffee break, he heard Elizabeth share more about her stresses; they seemed quite severe to him.
- He thought professional help might benefit her but was concerned about offending her. He told her he appreciated her sharing and asked if she had considered talking to a professional.
- He heard Elizabeth say she had thought about it, wasn’t sure, and was hesitant about seeking help.
- Afterward, he noticed Elizabeth became slightly withdrawn. He believed his suggestion might have embarrassed her and felt regretful.
- He told her he hoped he hadn’t overstepped by suggesting professional help and that he was there to support her no matter what.
- He heard Elizabeth say he hadn’t overstepped, that she appreciated his concern, and that it was just a lot to think about.
- After that conversation, he observed Elizabeth seeming more open and appreciative. He believed she valued his support and felt more comfortable around him.
- He told her he was glad they could talk and that he was always available if she needed to chat or take a break together.
- He heard Elizabeth thank him, say it meant a lot, and that she felt better knowing she had his support.
- He intends to maintain this supportive relationship with her.
